items.title: Inbox marker is committed outside the effect's transaction
items.verification: Planned: fail the shipments insert after the marker, redeliver the event, expect one shipment.
items.impact: A failure after the marker leaves the event marked seen and the shipment never created; every redelivery is skipped.
items.fix: Insert the marker with tx.ExecContext so marker and effect commit together.

items.title: Nothing prevents two shipments for one order
items.verification: Planned: insert the same order_id twice, expect the second to be rejected.
items.impact: Two events for one order with different event IDs create two shipments.
items.fix: Add a unique constraint on shipments(order_id) or key the effect by order.
